purpose: Push real-world (PlantDoc / field-photo) accuracy to the absolute maximum the RTX 3050 Ti can handle. Trades PlantVillage val accuracy for field accuracy.

inference_recommendation.note: Use --tta-passes 4 at inference for free +1-3% accuracy from horizontal/vertical flip averaging.

notes: field_source_boost = 12.0 means PlantDoc images are sampled 12x more often than PlantVillage in stage 2.
stage2_controlled_fraction = 0.0 means stage 2 is PURE field photos. No PlantVillage in the stage 2 training set.
epochs_stage2 = 22 (up from 14): stage 2 is the field-learning stage, so we let it cook longer.
learning_rate_stage2 = 3e-5 (down from 7e-5): smaller LR for careful fine-tuning on the small noisy field dataset.
grad_accumulation_steps = 8 (up from 4): effective batch size 32 instead of 16 for more stable gradients without more VRAM.
early_stopping_patience = 8 (up from 5): field-photo loss curves are noisy, do not bail early.
focal_gamma = 2.5 (up from 2.0): focus loss harder on the difficult/misclassified field examples.
image_size kept at 320 to fit the RTX 3050 Ti 4GB VRAM. If you have more VRAM, try 384 for more lesion detail.
Training time: ~7-8 hours on RTX 3050 Ti. Run overnight.
